headline: Broad-based growth and margin gains lift raised guidance
summary_short: Agilent's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 10% y/y to $1.83B while GAAP EPS climbed 60% to $1.20; non-GAAP operating margin expanded 130bps to 26.4%, and management raised full-year revenue and EPS guidance.
summary_long: Revenue of $1.835B grew 10.0% reported (6.3% core) y/y, with all three segments higher: Life Sciences and Diagnostics +12%, CrossLab +6%, Applied Markets +14%. GAAP operating income was $399M (vs $300M) on a 21.7% margin; non-GAAP operating margin reached 26.4%, up 130bps y/y and 180bps sequentially. GAAP net income was $339M ($1.20 EPS, +60% y/y); non-GAAP net income $423M ($1.49 EPS, +14% y/y). Management raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $7.39B-$7.49B and non-GAAP EPS guidance to $6.00-$6.10, plus issued Q3 revenue guidance of $1.83B-$1.85B, citing continued operational momentum. Cash was $1.81B at quarter-end.

drivers.explanation: Broad-based strength across major end markets, strong operational execution, and continued benefit from the Ignite Operating System and replacement-cycle demand.
Growth was broad-based across all three segments: Life Sciences and Diagnostics +12%, CrossLab +6%, Applied Markets +14% y/y.
